verdict.rationale: The firm's own pages describe cross-border-adjacent venture capability. They cover FDI/ODI policy in M&A, advice to investors entering the Indian digital economy, start-ups scaling globally, and membership of the international CMS organisation. Its startup publication also analyses flip-structure ineligibility. However, no documented flip or redomiciliation mandates, international-investor financing rounds, or multi-jurisdiction financings appear. missing for 10: documented cross-border deal examples or tombstones, an explicit flip/redomiciliation or reverse-flip practice offering, multi-jurisdiction financing coordination evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: Whether supporting a start-up scaling globally, an investor entering the Indian digital economy, or an established enterprise adopting new technologies
detailed founder-facing analysis incl. flip-structure ineligibility
